CLARIFICATION / RESUME
Append evidence with If-Match -> new draft -> explicit Run (step 2).
Prior run inputs stay unchanged. Resume makes a new call over accumulated evidence.

g.text: room in source and content limits.
Process-local execution only: one worker / replica. No durable queue, automatic retry, or immutable audit ledger.
Remote work may finish after cancellation. Failed and interrupted records have no retry transition in this release.
